final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG(1.0 * s.boxy / s.boxz) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.avg_ratio, step1.record_count, step1.record_count - step2.avg_count AS count_difference FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND step1.record_count > step2.avg_count) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio), SUM(record_count), AVG(count_difference) FROM step3
